verdict.rationale:
Docs show the full account-provisioning path: create a personal/business customer as a PROSPECT and activate it (synctera-docs-18/31), run KYC/KYB identity and watchlist checks (synctera-docs-9/19/32), open DDA account types like SAVING/CHECKING (synctera-docs-33/20), and issue cards (synctera-docs-4/30) — all reachable via an API key issued in Sandbox where KYB is auto-passed and dedicated sandbox test cases exist to validate flows before going live (synctera-docs-14/35/25). Bank-partner network language implies these are real bank-held deposit accounts (synctera-docs-16/17), and an OpenAPI spec is live (synctera-probe-2).
missing for 10: explicit statement that accounts are FDIC-insured, and an end-to-end worked example tying prospect→verified→active account into one documented flow.
